requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Ink Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed ink bottles with 6,000-page yield for Black and CMY, and bottle size for CMY exceeding 8,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To meet market demand for higher page yield and reduce user intervention for ink replacement.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility with CISS IDS and tank integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Black and CMY bottles are keyed and deliver at least 6,000 pages for Black, 6,000 pages for CMY, and CMY bottle size supports >8,000 pages.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Ensure spill-free reliability in bottle design and operation.
requirements.Rationale: To prevent ink wastage and mess during bottle handling and refilling, improving customer experience.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on bottle and tank design improvements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink bottles must pass spill-free reliability tests under normal use conditions.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Integrate NOA-F with a metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, with no change to push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: To improve reliability and traceability of NOA-F, while maintaining existing user interface.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on NOA-F component design and assembly.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F units incorporate metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, and retain push-push and TDF mechanisms.

requirements.Title: Reuse SuperAmp Si PHA
requirements.Description: Reuse SuperAmp Si PHA in the new Magellan printer design.
requirements.Rationale: To leverage proven technology and reduce development costs.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on compatibility with new platform and ink systems.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp Si PHA is integrated and functional in Magellan printer prototypes.

requirements.Title: Reuse Magi / Nessie Ink (No Ink Reformulation)
requirements.Description: Use existing Magi and Nessie pigment inks without reformulation.
requirements.Rationale: To maintain ink quality, compatibility, and reduce validation cycles.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on ink system compatibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan printer operates with Magi and Nessie inks without reformulation.

requirements.Title: Reliability, WVTR, Air Gain, Flow Rate, and IDS Characterization & Modelling
requirements.Description: Characterize and model reliability, WVTR (Water Vapor Transmission Rate), air gain, flow rate, and IDS (Ink Delivery System), including startup and NOA-F End of Life.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure consistent performance and reliability throughout product lifecycle.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires data collection and modelling tools.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Validated models and test reports for reliability, WVTR, air gain, flow rate, and IDS characterization.

requirements.Title: Ink Stability Modelling for Tank and PQ Impact
requirements.Description: Model ink stability in tank and its impact on print quality (PQ).
requirements.Rationale: To optimize ink performance and maintain high print quality over time.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires tank design and ink system data.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink stability models demonstrate minimal PQ degradation over expected tank life.

requirements.Title: NOA-F as Service Parts in Warranty Support
requirements.Description: NOA-F components must be available as service parts for warranty support.
requirements.Rationale: To enable efficient service and repair during warranty period.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires supply chain and inventory management.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F parts are stocked and available for warranty service requests.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 technology on the lid of Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: To enhance lid functionality and possibly improve security or user experience.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on lid design and Acumen 6 integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Acumen 6 is operational and validated on printer lid.

requirements.Title: Factory Configuration Updates for NOA-F and Ink Cart
requirements.Description: Modify existing SA14 line for NOA-F, add Magi ink cart and labelling tool in Orcus 5. Assume PHA + Dry FI + USG + push-push are assembled in printer factory.
requirements.Rationale: To accommodate new components and streamline manufacturing.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on factory upgrade and process changes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SA14 line and Orcus 5 are updated and validated for NOA-F, Magi ink cart, and labelling tool assembly.

requirements.Title: Mold for 1 to 4 New Keyed Caps
requirements.Description: Develop mold tooling for 1 to 4 new keyed caps for ink bottles.
requirements.Rationale: To support the new ink bottle design and prevent misfilling.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on ink bottle design finalization.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Molds for new keyed caps are produced and tested for compatibility.

requirements.Title: Leverage Watt LE / Marconi Hi mech + CISS
requirements.Description: Leverage Watt LE and Marconi Hi mechanical platform and CISS (Continuous Ink Supply System) for Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce development time and cost by using existing platforms.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on compatibility of platforms with new features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan printer prototypes successfully integrate Watt LE, Marconi Hi, and CISS.

requirements.Title: Speed: 25/20ppm (PDL: 25/19ppm)
requirements.Description: Magellan printer must support print speeds of 25/20 pages per minute (PDL: 25/19ppm).
requirements.Rationale: To meet competitive performance benchmarks for target segments.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on hardware and firmware optimization.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves 25/20ppm (PDL: 25/19ppm) in test conditions.

requirements.Title: Support Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Magellan printer must allow customers to replace PHA and NOA-F components easily.
requirements.Rationale: To improve serviceability and reduce downtime for end users.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on component design and user instructions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PHA and NOA-F are replaceable by customers with minimal tools and clear instructions.

requirements.Title: Support New Warranty Page Life Goal of 80k Pages
requirements.Description: Magellan printer must support a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To provide longer warranty coverage and differentiate from competitors.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on reliability and component durability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer reliably prints 80,000 pages within warranty period under standard usage.

requirements.Title: SKU 2 (Hi + Hi PDL) PaaS
requirements.Description: Introduce SKU 2 with high page yield and high PDL (Page Description Language) as Product-as-a-Service (PaaS).
requirements.Rationale: To target SMB and enterprise segments with flexible service models.
requirements.Stakeholders: Product Management, Marketing, SMB, Enterprise Customers
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on service platform and SKU configuration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SKU 2 is available with high yield and high PDL, offered as PaaS.

requirements.Title: Reddington ID with Size Increase for Tank
requirements.Description: Magellan printer adopts Reddington industrial design with increased tank size; no change to Marconi-HI ADF.
requirements.Rationale: To accommodate higher ink capacity and maintain design consistency.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on tank design and ID update.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer features Reddington ID, tank size increased, ADF unchanged.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Use EPS foam packaging for Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: To protect product during shipping and meet environmental standards.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on packaging design and supply chain.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: EPS foam packaging is validated for drop/shipping tests and meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel requirements.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3 and LOT4 Requirement, Blue Angel for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Magellan printer must meet EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel certification requirements for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure environmental compliance and marketability in regulated markets.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on product design and certification processes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel certifications for PDL SKU.

requirements.Title: Input Tray and Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Modify input and output trays to align with tank protrusion and optimize size.
requirements.Rationale: To accommodate increased tank size and maintain usability.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on tank and tray design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays are redesigned and tested for compatibility with protruding tank.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display
requirements.Description: Magellan printer must feature a 4.3-inch CGD (Color Graphic Display).
requirements.Rationale: To improve user interface and control experience.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on display integration and firmware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer includes a functional 4.3-inch CGD display.

requirements.Title: Platform 4 Tubes – Leverage Sayan Sibstar Tubes, New Tube Routing & Integration
requirements.Description: Magellan printer platform must use 4 tubes, leveraging Sayan Sibstar tubes, with new routing and integration.
requirements.Rationale: To optimize ink delivery and support new tank design.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on tube design and integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer integrates 4 Sayan Sibstar tubes with new routing; validated for ink delivery.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management with Spit Platform Changes
requirements.Description: Service station must manage aerosol with spit platform changes due to tank design.
requirements.Rationale: To maintain print quality and reduce maintenance issues.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on service station and tank integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol management system is validated and effective with new tank and spit platform.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model with Tube and New Weights
requirements.Description: Model carriage dynamics and force considering new tube routing and weights.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure reliable operation and prevent mechanical failures.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on tube integration and carriage design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage dynamic and force models validated for new configuration.

requirements.Title: Paperpath to Support Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Paperpath must be designed to support increased page life (80k pages).
requirements.Rationale: To ensure durability and reliability for high-volume printing.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on paperpath design and materials.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paperpath validated for 80,000-page life under standard usage.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance Serviceable Part (Service Center) – Post 80k Life
requirements.Description: Ink maintenance must be serviceable at Service Center after 80,000-page life.
requirements.Rationale: To support post-warranty service and extend product lifecycle.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on maintenance part design and service procedures.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink maintenance part is replaceable/serviceable after 80k page life.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA, NOA-F, Keyed Bottles, Magi and Nessie Pigment Inks, 140ml K Bottles (New), xx ml CMY Bottles
requirements.Description: Magellan printer must support SuperAmp PHA, NOA-F, keyed bottles, Magi and Nessie pigment inks, new 140ml K bottles, and xx ml CMY bottles.
requirements.Rationale: To offer a comprehensive supply system for various print needs.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on supply system integration and compatibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer supports all listed supplies and bottle sizes; validated in test prints.

requirements.Title: IDS New Make-Break and FI Connection
requirements.Description: Implement new make-break and FI (Fluidic Interface) connection in IDS (Ink Delivery System).
requirements.Rationale: To improve reliability and ease of maintenance.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on IDS redesign and component compatibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: IDS features new make-break and FI connection; validated in prototype testing.

requirements.Title: Leverage LEBI Ink-Tank with Increased Size, Keying and LOI One SHAID
requirements.Description: Use LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI One SHAID for Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: To support high-capacity ink supply and secure identification.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on ink-tank design and LOI SHAID integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: LEBI ink-tank is integrated with increased size, keying, and LOI One SHAID; validated in printer operation.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop new IDS startup algorithm and air management system.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure optimal startup performance and prevent air-related failures.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on IDS design and firmware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: IDS startup algorithm and air management validated for reliable printer startup.

requirements.Title: New Servicing and Startup Algorithm
requirements.Description: Implement new servicing and startup algorithms for Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: To improve reliability and reduce service incidents.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on printer firmware and servicing procedures.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Servicing and startup algorithms validated in field tests.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality Goals & Depletion to Meet Page Yield Definition
requirements.Description: Set new print quality (PQ) goals and depletion metrics to meet defined page yield.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure consistent print quality and accurate yield reporting.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on ink system and PQ testing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PQ goals and depletion metrics validated for defined page yield.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU, Stingray Wi-fi Module, FW Dune
requirements.Description: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU, Stingray Wi-fi module, and FW Dune in Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: To leverage proven electronic and firmware components, reducing development risk and cost.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on compatibility with Magellan platform.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed components are integrated and validated in Magellan printer.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security for Hardware and Firmware
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx security for hardware and firmware in Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure robust security and protect against threats.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on hardware and firmware integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Gauss4.xx security features operational and validated in Magellan printer.

requirements.Title: Business Model: Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise Support
requirements.Description: Magellan printer must support business models for Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise segments.
requirements.Rationale: To expand market reach and address diverse customer needs.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on solution and service platform integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer and services are available for Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise customers.

requirements.Title: Solution and Services: Scan Solution, SMB Manageability, Enterprise Support
requirements.Description: Magellan printer must provide scan solution, SMB manageability, and enterprise support (WJA, HPSM, JAM).
requirements.Rationale: To offer comprehensive solutions for targeted segments.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on software and service integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer supports scan solution, SMB manageability, and enterprise features (WJA, HPSM, JAM).

requirements.Title: Clients & Drivers: HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, UFD
requirements.Description: Magellan printer must support clients and drivers including HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure compatibility with HP ecosystem and user platforms.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on driver and client integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer supports all listed clients and drivers; validated in installation tests.

requirements.Title: Protect Micro/SMB Segments and Safeguard HP’s Ink/Laser Profit Pool
requirements.Description: Magellan printer must be designed to protect HP's market share in Micro and SMB segments and prevent profit pool erosion to competitors.
requirements.Rationale: To maintain HP's leadership and profitability.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on competitive features and pricing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Market share in Micro/SMB segments maintained or increased post-launch.

requirements.Title: Lead with LaserJet and Flank with PDL in Medium and Enterprise
requirements.Description: Magellan printer must support strategy to lead with LaserJet and flank with PDL in Medium and Enterprise segments to win over competitors.
requirements.Rationale: To strengthen HP’s position in Medium and Enterprise segments against competitors like Epson.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on product positioning and feature set.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Competitive positioning validated in market analysis and sales results.

requirements.Title: Grow CISS Profitable Share by Playing in New Segments
requirements.Description: Magellan printer must enable growth of profitable CISS share by targeting new market segments.
requirements.Rationale: To expand HP's CISS market share and profitability.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on segment identification and tailored features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: CISS share grows in new segments post-launch.

requirements.Title: Highly Leverage Watt-LE Mech Platform, Marconi-Hi Product (Reddington ID), and Solutions
requirements.Description: Magellan printer must leverage Watt-LE mechanical platform, Marconi-Hi product (Reddington ID), and solutions for development.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce development time and cost by using proven platforms and solutions.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on platform compatibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan printer development leverages all listed platforms and solutions.

requirements.Title: Integrate CISS IDS, NOA-F, and Ink Tanks
requirements.Description: Magellan printer must integrate CISS IDS, NOA-F, and ink tanks for seamless operation.
requirements.Rationale: To optimize ink delivery and reliability.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on system integration and compatibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer integrates CISS IDS, NOA-F, and ink tanks; validated in operation tests.

requirements.Title: New NGB Keyed Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Magellan printer must use new NGB keyed ink bottles.
requirements.Rationale: To prevent misfilling and ensure correct ink usage.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on bottle design and keying system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer accepts only keyed NGB bottles; validated in user tests.

requirements.Title: Schedule Constraint: Q3 2025 Launch
requirements.Description: Magellan printer development must adhere to schedule with launch by August 20, 2025 (Q3 2025).
requirements.Rationale: To meet market timing and business objectives.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on project management and milestone tracking.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer is launched by August 20, 2025.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K Pages (Constraint)
requirements.Description: SuperAmp PHA must have a life of 65,000 pages as a constraint.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure reliability and meet service requirements.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on PHA design and testing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA reliably operates for 65,000 pages.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of Pages, 2 Years (Optimize)
requirements.Description: Magellan printer must optimize for warranty life of pages and 2-year coverage.
requirements.Rationale: To provide competitive warranty terms and customer assurance.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on reliability and warranty policy.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer is warranted for defined page life and 2 years.

requirements.Title: Throughput 25/20 PDL (Optimize)
requirements.Description: Magellan printer must optimize for throughput of 25/20 pages per minute (PDL).
requirements.Rationale: To meet performance expectations for target segments.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on hardware and firmware optimization.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves throughput of 25/20 PDL in test conditions.

requirements.Title: Serviceability Maintenance Box (Optimize)
requirements.Description: Magellan printer must optimize for serviceability via maintenance box.
requirements.Rationale: To improve ease of maintenance and reduce downtime.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on maintenance box design and service procedures.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box is serviceable and validated in service tests.

requirements.Title: SMB Solution (Optimize)
requirements.Description: Magellan printer must optimize for SMB solution features.
requirements.Rationale: To address SMB segment needs and improve manageability.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on solution integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer delivers SMB solution features validated in SMB use cases.

requirements.Title: PaaS Schedule (Optimize)
requirements.Description: Magellan printer must optimize for PaaS (Product-as-a-Service) schedule.
requirements.Rationale: To align service offerings with product launch.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on PaaS platform readiness.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PaaS offering is available at product launch.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK (Flexible)
requirements.Description: Magellan printer must flexibly support hosting 12,000-page yield for CMYK.
requirements.Rationale: To enable higher capacity options for certain markets.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on ink system and bottle design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer supports 12,000-page yield for CMYK; validated in test prints.

requirements.Title: Trade Page 6K (Flexible)
requirements.Description: Magellan printer must flexibly support trade page yield of 6,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To enable product configuration for trade and channel requirements.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on configuration options.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer supports trade page yield of 6,000 pages; validated in channel tests.
